About Vision Style

Our Store

Vision Style is a complete eyewear studio — frames, sunglasses, prescription lenses, contact lenses and eyecare accessories, all under one roof with in-store eye testing.

Why Us

500+ frame styles from everyday essentials to premium brands, fitted by trained opticians. Every lens is checked twice before it reaches your eyes.

Home Service

Can't visit? Book a home eye test and try frames at your doorstep with our virtual try-on and home trial service.

Our Promise

Honest pricing, free fitting and adjustments for a year, and a 7-day no-question return on every frame.

Contact Us

Questions about a frame, your order, or an eye test? Write to us — we reply fast.
